items.name: Angelic Weapons
entries: The deva's weapon attacks are magical. When the deva hits with any weapon, the weapon deals an extra {@damage 1d10} radiant damage (included in the attack).

items.name: Multiattack
entries: The deva makes four melee attacks.

items.name: Shortsword
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d6 + 4}) slashing damage plus 13 ({@damage 1d10}) radiant damage.
